summary: Flat dip on a quiet street, but homes 13-14 m away on both sides.

best_section.where: Woolley Street west kerb, in the low point south of the steep climb

drivers.seclusion: Houses and gardens 13-17 m away on the kerb's side, more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a gravel strip beside the lane; room to park a van off the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, near the bushland dead end; light traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs; a few cars park along the kerb, no overnight convention.

flags: Steep elsewhere: 12.7% mean, 29% max; flat only in the dip
Mapped gate 150 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades much of the west kerb; afternoon sun from the west mostly screened.
